description: Add CKCC NPA Accounts under KRM OTS Scheme Field Report as a new separate report type. This creates a dedicated form for NPA accounts being handled under the KRM OTS scheme. Combines NPA account details with OTS settlement fields. No Borrower Signature.
steps: 1. In VisitFormData.kt companion object, add new constant REPORT_CKCC_NPA_OTS = "ckcc_npa_ots" and add it to REPORT_TYPES list.
2. In VisitFormData.kt, add new fields for the CKCC NPA OTS report section, prefixed with 'npaOts'.
4. In VisitFormData.kt toFieldMap(), add block for REPORT_CKCC_NPA_OTS.
6. In activity_visit_report.xml, add include for npa_ots section.
7. In VisitReportActivity.kt, add setUpNpaOts() and toggle visibility in applyReportType().
8. Add NPA OTS string resources to strings.xml.
acceptance_criteria: The report type dropdown shows 'CKCC NPA - KRM OTS Scheme' as an option
Selecting it shows the NPA OTS partial layout with all required sections
All NPA OTS fields are serialized to the field map under 'npa_ots_details[...]' prefix
No Borrower Signature field exists in this form
findings: All code is in place and build passes. The NPA OTS form layout, data model fields, validation, serialization, and activity wiring are all complete.
